design_scope_reviewed: Full action labels: _full_label disables clip and trimming on Save, Export, Open, Delete, Copy, Import and Close. HFlowContainer rows with 8px separation wrap instead of compressing. Astra saw full labels in 4 locales × 2 themes at 960x640/200% and 1400x950/100%.

Footer and Close reachability: the body is in a vertical-only ScrollContainer with follow_focus, and the footer HBox sits outside the scroll inside the layout VBox. Astra saw Close and the footer in all 32 frames, including the two-line Japanese footer, with no overlap.
Window sizing: 760x520 scaled by ui_scale, clamped to the root visible rect minus 32px and two scaled title heights. At 960x640/200% this gives 928x480, above min_size 640x450. At 1400x950 it fits.

Confirmations: dialog_autowrap with a fixed width of font_size(420), clamped to the available width, so height grows from content. Astra saw full import and delete warnings plus OK/Cancel in all 16 confirmation frames.

Palette: the dialog panel StyleBoxFlat uses only the existing SsokTheme.BG. It is synced on NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED and immediately before each popup. This fixes the observed 1.117 dark-theme contrast. The live visible-dialog light/dark roundtrip and Astra's 16 dark/light confirmation frames agree. If remember/adapt also records this override, the result is the same role, so it is harmless.

Preservation: no new colors, fonts, type scale or strings. Content margin 12 and separation 8 are spacing only. Graph/code/import/delete confirmation semantics are unchanged: _request_replace, request_delete and _confirm_action keep their logic and only route through _popup_confirmation. Escape-to-close is unchanged while a confirmation is visible.
Code idiom: tabs, static typing, why-comments, and helper naming consistent with the file.
nonblocking_limits: Compact 960x640/200% Saved view: the library, Open and Delete lie below the initial scroll viewport. Stills cannot certify they are reachable. The OS Escape/Tab/Enter 6/0 run used the earlier layout 9e3330de, which has the same layout and input paths, and has no final 200% OS focus or scroll claim. Mark it unrun, not passed.

Mouse-wheel scrolling over the nested ItemList or TextEdit scrolls the inner control first. At compact 200% the outer scroll then depends on the scrollbar, the gutters or keyboard follow_focus. This was not verified by OS input.
Window size is computed only at open_panel, and the window is unresizable. A root-window resize while Projects is open will not reflow it. This was not tested.

No coverage below 960x640 or above 200%. An unwrappable single label wider than the row would overflow, because labels never trim and horizontal scroll is disabled. No such case was observed in the matrix.

Pre-existing and not in the diff: error status uses modulate Color("ff9292") instead of a SsokTheme.ERROR role. In the light theme this tints dark text rather than showing the palette error color. Error distinctness in the light theme is not certified here.

`_confirmation.theme = theme` copies the Window's theme at _ready, which is likely null. If an owner later assigns a theme to the panel, the dialog will not follow automatically. Inheritance through the parent Window currently covers this.
The title-height reserve, 2 × font_size(36) + 16, is a heuristic tied to the embedded-window title font. It held at the tested sizes only.
Web/Linux draft build and gate for this source are pending. Native Mac is unrun. Exact numeric contrast was coordinator-measured (min 14.5095), not independently computed by Astra or by me.
The immutable r2 provider/camera smoke (12/0) predates this UI change and is not evidence for it. Backend model, physical goal, package runtime and publication are out of scope and uncertified.

The harness failures from the first and corrected matrix runs (1249/536, 1169/160) are correctly kept as harness or checker errors, not app passes. The dark-contrast app bug was real and is fixed in this source.
